### Class booking not available

You cannot reserve this class for one of the following reasons:

- It is less than 30 min before class
- Attempting to book prior to online booking window
- Class is fully booked
- Class not included in your membership type
- New terms and conditions not accepted
- Membership not active
- More than 5 class reservations today
- Have an overlapping reservation

![Crunch Fitness Training](https://dj7w0h47bhjwk.cloudfront.net/assets/coming-soon/why-choose-crunch-42bc2150f99a23e80e3744484fafcd9d3f5c0195f1848609fab7daaa37e10eb2.png)

### Industry-Leading Strength & Cardio Equipment

Austin has some great gyms, but Crunch's commitment to its members is uncanny. Our top-notch equipment rivals the very best gyms in the industry. We are dedicated to our “No Judgments” philosophy andan inclusive environment. If it isn't for the fun of it, then why even do it? Right?

From state-of-the-art strength and cardio machines to high-intensity interval training gear, we have everything you need to turn your fitness goals into reality.

Whether you prefer individual workouts, group fitness, or personalized guidance from our expert personal trainers, Crunch supports your fitness journey.

We believe in the power of team training and a supportive community, ensuring that your experience at Crunch is not just another visit to the gym but a transformative step towards becoming the best version of yourself.

### World-Class Personal Trainers

At Crunch Fitness Austin, we understand that everyone's fitness journey is unique. That's why we offer a team of local fitness guides here to provide one-on-one guidance, motivation, and support tailored to your unique needs and fitness goals.

Think of our trainers as your personal fitness guides, leading you through your workouts, strength training, and overall fitness journey.

We offer a variety of group fitness classes led by passionate coaches dedicated to teaching and instilling confidence in you, all for free as part of your Crunch membership inAustin.

### Famous Group Fitness Classes

Joining Crunch is not just about exercising and getting fit; it's about making serious fitness fun.

We believe in fostering a supportive community and respectful workout environment where you can have a blast while breaking a sweat and walk away with newfound confidence.

Our great gym in Austin offers state-of-the-art facilities and certified trainers passionate about teaching and pushing you to achieve your fitness goals. There's something for everyone, from incredible Zumba-based classes to our amazing HIIT zone.

We teach various options for all fitness levels and unique needs, all included for free in your membership. Group class at Crunch is when our members are faced with what exercise should be like. It is a fun, balanced experience, not only a matter of performance and metrics.

Our commitment to a respectful and supportive workout environment ensures that every fitness adventure is not just about breaking a sweat but also about breaking into a wide grin.

Our coaches are here to guide and coach you every step of the way, making sure you have a great workout and teaching you the passion and dedication it takes to achieve your fitness goals and dreams.

### Member Benefits

We believe that fitness should be accessible to everyone, regardless of their budget. Crunch offers a range of flexible membership options that cater to a wide range of budgets. Our certified trainers are here to guide you through a functional and effective workout experience, whether your focus is on weight lifting, losing weight, or simply improving your overall fitness. Plus, our club boasts a variety of amenities to enhance your workout, ensuring that you have a well-rounded fitness experience that suits your needs and budget. That's why we offer a range of flexible membership options.

### Where are you located?

![+](https://dj7w0h47bhjwk.cloudfront.net/assets/coming-soon/faq-plus-icon-0637f981adc5e37ba9df5228a055ed389004cd146f1dfe45098cc13d3ac0697e.svg)![—](https://dj7w0h47bhjwk.cloudfront.net/assets/coming-soon/faq-minus-icon-22c71468f6cee2e05fc7e5a2688a11eed7e33d4907f5460286760d7a002b67f1.svg)

We’re located at 4625 W William Cannon on William Cannon and Mopac.Lil Doddy, Panera Bread, and Southwest bible church are a few key retailers in the complex. We’re close to St. Edwards University.

### What makes your location unique?

![+](https://dj7w0h47bhjwk.cloudfront.net/assets/coming-soon/faq-plus-icon-0637f981adc5e37ba9df5228a055ed389004cd146f1dfe45098cc13d3ac0697e.svg)![—](https://dj7w0h47bhjwk.cloudfront.net/assets/coming-soon/faq-minus-icon-22c71468f6cee2e05fc7e5a2688a11eed7e33d4907f5460286760d7a002b67f1.svg)

Crunch is conveniently located in South Austin and offers workouts for everyone from busy professionals to parents and students. Crunch has a variety of Group Fitness classes including Ride, Boxing, HIIT Training, dance and cardio formats. Relax & Recover with HydroMassage®, Tanning and Red Light Therapy services.
